entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi, Sarah. I'm calling about my VeloBand Cadence Sensor. I'm just... so disappointed. It's not working at all like it should.
I'm very sorry to hear that. I can definitely look into this for you. To be sure I understand, is it a technical fault with the device or more of a preference issue?
It's a fault. The pulse reading is completely wrong. It says my heart rate is 50 when I'm sprinting. Honestly, this thing is just a piece of garbage.

I understand your frustration. A faulty reading would be very concerning. I can transfer you to our technical support team. They have advanced tools to diagnose and troubleshoot sensor issues right over the phone.
Oh, no... I really don't have time for all that. I've been a loyal customer for years, and I saved up for this. I just want my money back. Can I please just get a refund?
I see. You're not interested in troubleshooting and would prefer to return the item. Let me just pull up your order details and check the policy for you. Can you confirm your last name?
It's Miller. I really needed this money for some bills. I hope this isn't going to be a problem.

Okay, Mr. Miller, thank you. I see your order. You received the VeloBand Cadence Sensor 37 days ago. Let me just check our return eligibility... Yes, it looks like you're unfortunately outside our 10-day return window.

I can go ahead and approve this return for a full refund for you right now. I'm emailing you a pre-paid shipping label. Just pack the sensor in its original box, attach the label, and drop it at any post office.
Oh! Really? That's... that's a huge relief. Thank you so much, Sarah. I really appreciate your help.
You're very welcome, Mr. Miller. Once we receive the item, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
